# False positive samples - none of these may trigger secret-scan patterns.

# Base64 that starts with letters, not an AWS key
dGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3Q=

# Short AKIA prefix (not 16 chars of key body)
AKIA123

# Empty / placeholder assignments
password = ""
password = "xxx"
api_key = ""

# Documentation mentions of token formats without values
the token format is xoxb-NUMBER
GitHub PATs start with ghp_ followed by 36 characters
Anthropic keys start with the sk-ant- prefix
